turns.question: What was our CPA on search in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric named CPA; its one definition of cost per conversion is cost per booking, so on the search channel from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30 the cost per booking was 124.84 EUR (total search ad spend over total search bookings). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
